name: Appliance Repair Inbound Calls

hero.headline: Appliance Repair Inbound Calls
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for appliance repair solutions.

overview: Appliance Repair Inbound Calls are consumers who see an offer and dial in themselves, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Reach households with broken refrigerators, washers, dryers, ovens and dishwashers and connect them with appliance repair technicians.

Someone whose refrigerator has just stopped cooling is going to pick up the phone, not wait for an email reply. Inbound Call programs place local appliance repair offers in front of households searching at the moment of failure and connect them directly to the company's scheduling line. Callers arrive ready to book a diagnostic visit, and companies that can offer a prompt appointment window and a clear service fee convert these calls at a high rate. Programs can be filtered by appliance type and brand to match technician expertise and parts inventory.

This product is suited to home services businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of appliance repair consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Homeowners and renters with a malfunctioning major appliance, including refrigerators, freezers, washers, dryers, ranges, ovens, dishwashers and microwaves. The most valuable segments are owners of premium and built-in appliances where repair is clearly preferable to replacement, households with multiple appliances of similar age, and landlords who need reliable repair partners for their properties.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for appliance repair near me or a specific appliance and brand repair; refrigerator not cooling, freezer thawing or ice maker failing; washer not draining, dryer not heating or making unusual noises; oven not heating, range burner failure or dishwasher not cleaning.
howGenerated: Calls are generated through call-only and click-to-call performance campaigns targeting searches such as "appliance repair near me" and "refrigerator repair near me", alongside social and comparison placements. Every source is tracked, so call quality can be traced back to the campaign that produced it.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard appliance repair criteria include: property located within the company's service area; appliance type and brand identified; symptom or failure described for technician preparation; appliance approximate age and warranty status noted; homeowner, tenant with authority or property manager confirmed; ready to schedule a diagnostic visit and accept a service fee.
delivery: Calls are routed to your sales line in real time by state or ZIP, schedule and agent availability, with concurrency limits and daily caps set to your capacity. Call tracking and recording are available for quality control.

faq.q: Can calls be filtered by appliance type or brand?
faq.a: Yes. Screening identifies the appliance and brand so that you can accept only the categories and manufacturers your technicians service, including premium brands if you specialise.

faq.q: Do you screen out appliances still under manufacturer warranty?
faq.a: Warranty status is captured during screening, and consumers who must use an authorised warranty provider can be excluded unless you are an authorised servicer.

faq.q: How quickly do consumers expect service?
faq.a: Most callers want same-day or next-day appointments, particularly for refrigeration failures, so programs work best for companies with responsive scheduling capacity.
